conventions: Use multi-line `/** ... */` TSDoc blocks for all added or updated documentation comments; never modify executable statements, type declarations, imports, exports, or existing Apache-2.0 license headers and copyright years.
Never add `@public` or `@alpha` release tags to interface properties or class methods; release tags belong only on top-level exported declarations.

Format parameter tags with a hyphen separator (`@param <name> - <description>`) and place `@param` after `@public` on top-level functions (matching `packages/catalog-model/src/entity/ref.ts`) or at the end of the method TSDoc block on class methods (matching `packages/catalog-model/src/validation/CommonValidatorFunctions.ts`).

Write U.S. English prose in present tense and active voice per `docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md`, wrapping inline code and field names in backticks and avoiding Latin abbreviations (`e.g.`, `i.e.`).
Format all modified TypeScript and Markdown files with Prettier (`yarn prettier --write`).

decisions.topic: Entity kind type guard TSDoc structure in `src/entity/conditions.ts`
decisions.choice: Expand each existing `/** @public */` comment in place into a single multi-line TSDoc block containing a summary sentence noting case-insensitive `entity.kind` matching, followed by `@public` and `@param entity - The entity to check`.
rejected: Adding a second TSDoc block above `/** @public */`
decisions.reason: API Extractor attaches only the immediately preceding TSDoc block to the export, and existing functions in `src/entity/ref.ts` place summary first, then `@public`, then `@param`.

decisions.choice: Add a multi-line TSDoc block above each of the 8 static methods with a summary sentence starting with `Checks that the value is ...` that states the exact validation rule and `@param value - The value to check`, with no release tag.
rejected: Generic summaries that omit length or character-set rules
decisions.reason: Matches `CommonValidatorFunctions` in the same directory and satisfies API Extractor rules plus NFR-3 accuracy.

decisions.choice: Add a multi-line `/** ... */` block containing `{@inheritDoc EntityPolicy.enforce}` above `async enforce(entity: Entity): Promise<Entity>` in each of the 5 policy classes, with no release tag.
rejected: Duplicating custom prose across all 5 `enforce` methods
decisions.reason: All 5 classes implement `EntityPolicy.enforce`, NFR-2 requires multi-line `/** ... */` blocks and `{@inheritDoc ...}` where appropriate, and API Extractor resolves `{@inheritDoc EntityPolicy.enforce}` cleanly.

decisions.choice: Add summary-only multi-line `/** ... */` blocks (no release tags) to `apiVersion`, `kind`, and `spec` on all 8 `*EntityV1alpha1` interfaces, aligning wording with `Entity` (`src/entity/Entity.ts`) and each kind's JSON schema (`src/schema/kinds/<Kind>.v1alpha1.schema.json`).
rejected: Using `{@inheritDoc Entity.apiVersion}` on narrowed literal properties
decisions.reason: Follows `Entity` and `EntityMeta` member TSDoc style in `src/entity/Entity.ts` and provides kind-specific context from the JSON schemas.

decisions.choice: Do not include `report.api.md` or `report-alpha.api.md` as typed units; let the Gate 0 test command (`yarn build:api-reports && ! grep -q "(undocumented)" packages/catalog-model/report.api.md`) regenerate them after source comments land.
decisions.reason: FR-5 and Gate 0 forbid hand-editing API Extractor reports and require regeneration exclusively via `yarn build:api-reports`.

decisions.choice: Create `.changeset/catalog-model-tsdoc-comments.md` with a `patch` bump for `@backstage/catalog-model` and a concise adopter-facing summary of the TSDoc improvements.
rejected: Listing raw internal file paths or all 45 symbol names in the changeset
decisions.reason: Satisfies FR-6 and NFR-6 for a published package (`@backstage/catalog-model`).

units.behaviour: Add accurate multi-line TSDoc comments with summaries and @param tags to all 8 static validation methods on KubernetesValidatorFunctions.
rules: Insert a multi-line `/** ... */` TSDoc block before each of the 8 static methods without adding `@public` or `@alpha` release tags.
Include `@param value - The value to check` in every method's TSDoc block, matching `CommonValidatorFunctions`.
State each method's exact validation rules accurately in its summary sentence.

sites.rule: Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes apiVersion string (an optional DNS subdomain prefix followed by '/' and a 1-63 character alphanumeric [a-z0-9A-Z] suffix), with '@param value - The value to check'.

Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes kind string (1-63 characters starting with a letter [a-zA-Z] followed by alphanumeric characters [a-z0-9A-Z]), with '@param value - The value to check'.

Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes object name string (1-63 characters starting and ending with an alphanumeric character [A-Za-z0-9] and containing only alphanumerics, dashes, underscores, and dots [-A-Za-z0-9_.] in between), with '@param value - The value to check'.
Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes namespace string (a valid RFC 1123 DNS label), with '@param value - The value to check'.

Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes label key string (an optional DNS subdomain prefix followed by '/' and a valid object name suffix), with '@param value - The value to check'.

Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes label value string (an empty string or a valid object name), with '@param value - The value to check'.

Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes annotation key string (an optional DNS subdomain prefix followed by '/' and a valid object name suffix), with '@param value - The value to check'.
Insert a multi-line TSDoc block (no release tag) stating that it checks that the value is a valid Kubernetes annotation value (any string), with '@param value - The value to check'.
